null: r must be an object with symbol_id, target, outcome, binding, and attempts
array: r must be an object with symbol_id, target, outcome, binding, and attempts
string: r must be an object with symbol_id, target, outcome, binding, and attempts
empty: r.symbol_id must be a non-empty proof symbol ID (SYM-*)
r.target must be a non-empty execution target
r.outcome must be one of: passed, failed, timed_out, skipped, interrupted, errored; received null
r.binding must be one of: native_case, aggregate_run; received null
r.attempts must be an object: {status: "complete", entries: [...]} or {status: "unavailable"}
blankStrings: r.symbol_id must be a non-empty proof symbol ID (SYM-*)
r.target must be a non-empty execution target
r.native_id must be a non-empty string when present
badEnums: r.outcome must be one of: passed, failed, timed_out, skipped, interrupted, errored; received "great"
r.binding must be one of: native_case, aggregate_run; received "loose"
attemptsNull: r.attempts must be an object: {status: "complete", entries: [...]} or {status: "unavailable"}
attemptsNoStatus: r.attempts.status must be one of: complete, unavailable; received null
attemptsBadStatus: r.attempts.status must be one of: complete, unavailable; received "partial"
unavailableWithEntries: r.attempts.entries must be omitted when status is unavailable
completeNoEntries: r.attempts.entries must be a non-empty array when status is complete
completeEmpty: r.attempts.entries must be a non-empty array when status is complete
completeNotArray: r.attempts.entries must be a non-empty array when status is complete
entries: r.attempts.entries[0] must be an object with outcome (and optional duration_ms)
r.attempts.entries[1].outcome must be one of: passed, failed, timed_out, skipped, interrupted, errored; received null
r.attempts.entries[2].outcome must be one of: passed, failed, timed_out, skipped, interrupted, errored; received "great"
r.attempts.entries[3].duration_ms must be a non-negative integer; received -1
r.attempts.entries[4].duration_ms must be a non-negative integer; received 1.5
r.attempts.entries[5].duration_ms must be a non-negative integer; received "3"
r.attempts.entries[6].duration_ms must be a non-negative integer; received null
diagnosticsString: r.diagnostics must be an array of non-empty strings
diagnosticsBlank: r.diagnostics must be an array of non-empty strings
